title: Compute the Shopping Total
prompt:
Given `const price = 4.5` and `const quantity = 3`, compute `total` and log a sentence using the variables, like `3 items cost 13.5`. Then log whether the total is more than 10 (a boolean).

Rules:
- Use arithmetic on the variables — no hard-coded 13.5.

tests.name: total is price times quantity
tests.hint: const total = price * quantity; — the computer does the math.

tests.name: logs a sentence using the variables
logs the boolean comparison
